title: A failing test with two causes
prompt: `python3 -m unittest` fails in this project. Fix report.py (not the tests) so it passes. data/expenses.csv is a real export from my bank, so report.py has to handle that format properly, not just this one file.
notes: Recovery: the first failure (an off-by-one that drops the last row) hides a second (a quoted amount with a thousands separator, which split(',') can't parse). Hidden tests use another export with a quoted category and amount, so special-casing the visible file fails. The visible test is restored before grading.
